message.content: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪;骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Sun obtained false VAT invoices (虚开增值税专用发票) and used them to deduct tax, defrauding state tax of 77517.1 yuan. That's crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (Crime of falsifying special VAT invoices) under Chinese criminal law. Also "骗取国家税款罪" (fraudulently obtaining state tax). In Chinese law, the offense is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" which is under the crime of "虚开增值税专用发票" (falsely issuing VAT invoices). The act of using false invoices to claim tax deduction is part of that crime. Also could be "税务诈骗罪"? Actually Chinese law: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" is separate. Also "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪"? The law includes "虚开增值税专用发票罪" and "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪". The facts: He obtained false invoices and used them to deduct tax, defrauding state tax. So both crimes may apply: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" and "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪". However the typical charge is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (including using for tax evasion). The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts directly support "虚开增值税专用发票罪" and "骗取国家税款罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪" (Article 205 of Criminal Law). Actually Article 205: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" includes using false invoices to claim tax deduction. Also there is "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪" (Article 205). Let's see: Under Chinese law, "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪" is separate: "以虚假的增值税专用发票骗取税款的" etc. So both could be charged. The typical prosecution charges both: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" and "骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪". The facts: He obtained false invoices (虚开) and used them to deduct tax, defrauding state tax. So both.

Thus answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪;骗取增值税发票抵扣税款罪<eoa>
